notes.title: Save 50% on Joyfess in Celebration of the 1st Anniversary
notes.notes:
Greetings, almighty kraken slayers of the past and professional chefs of the future! We are happy to announce that we're celebrating the 1st year anniversary of Joyfess with a one-week 50% discount.

We will be making more announcements as we make progress with achievements and the next installment.

Have fun!

notes.title: New Dialogue Options & More In The April Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hello, cooks of the Caribbean! This gameplay update brings a host of tweaks to make game flow less stiff.
[list][*]Two new "hint comments" added.
[*]Some of the longer dialogues are now better broken down into smaller, easier chunks to swallow, with a couple new dialogue options added as well. This may result in a bug in the display of dialogue options. More info: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1095700/discussions/0/2266942281796123430/
[*]New sound effects added (booth & final chapter).
[*]Inspecting the coal is no longer a prerequisite for picking it up.
[*]Minor improvements, bug fixes and some text corrections.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=Lk-JTyTAWoo;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lk-JTyTAWoo[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: What's New in Version 2020.04.02.b?
notes.notes:
Version 2020.04.02.b has just been released. So what's new in this patch update?
[list][*]The Booth Scene: SFX have been improved (more to come soon for this scene and other scenes).
[*]The Restaurant Scene: You no longer have to "hunt" for the Empty Frame the first time you play the game. Now when you start with looking at the Concept Art Pictures, the game will treat that as looking at the Empty Frame as well. The less pixel hunting, the better!
[*]This one is an Easter egg that you will uncover as you play the game (Yes, you will know it when you see it!). :)
[*]Minor bug fixes and fine-tuning improvements.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=B4w5TRuUIlU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Joyfess Is Coming Out On 27 March, Watch The Main Trailer Here
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XeM5PQZlpfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Who wants to be a pirate in the Caribbean when you could be a cook? That's all our hero wants to do. Join Joyfess Tidesman in his adventure in this classic, 90s-inspired point-and-click adventure as he tries to fetch a cooking recipe and gather its ingredients!

Joyfess Ep1: Martin's Secret Recipe will be out on Steam on Friday 27 March. Don't hesitate to wishlist it now!

For press purposes, refer to our downloadable press kit [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SO695Q7BcCaQZw8giLn_5EO6HdJ-uagR]here.[/url]
